requirements.statement: Repository-structure Conformance SHALL evaluate the actual filesystem namespace beneath the repository root rather than only tracked, maintained, generated, or preclassified objects.
For every observed filesystem object beneath the repository root, Conformance SHALL resolve applicable structural authorization.
For every repository-structure configuration entry requiring presence, Conformance SHALL verify that the required filesystem object exists.

Repository-structure Conformance SHALL fail when governed state does not determine exactly one canonical structure-configuration identity or that identity does not resolve to exactly one configuration object.
